description: Collect public Threads profiles, posts, replies, media, reposts, keyword or hashtag search results, and full reply threads. No login, cookies, or API key required.

includeMediaUrls.description: Store photos and videos in the run's key-value store so their links keep working after Threads' signed CDN links expire. Turn off to keep the original links.
includeMediaUrls.title: Rehost media files

includeProfileInfo.description: For profile modes, also output one profile record per username with bio, follower count, verification, links, and topics.
includeProfileInfo.title: Include profile record

maxItems.description: Maximum number of post, reply, or discovered-profile records to return.
maxItems.title: Max items

postUrls.description: Threads post links (threads.com or threads.net). Each returns the post and its reply thread. Used by mode=postReplies.
postUrls.title: Post URLs (mode=postReplies)

postedAfter.description: Optional lower date bound. Accepts ISO dates (2026-01-31) or relative windows such as 7d, 24h, or 2w.
postedAfter.title: Published after

postedBefore.description: Optional upper date bound. Accepts ISO dates or relative windows such as 7d, 24h, or 2w.
postedBefore.title: Published before

searchQueries.description: Keywords, phrases, or #hashtags. Used by mode=search and mode=profilesByKeyword.
searchQueries.title: Search queries (mode=search / profilesByKeyword)

sortBy.description: Order for keyword search results: Top (relevance) or Recent (newest first). 'default' is accepted as an alias of Top.
sortBy.title: Search order (mode=search)

tag.description: Hashtag or topic to search without the # sign, e.g. 'ai' or 'mma'. Used by mode=tag.
tag.title: Hashtag / topic (mode=tag)

usernames.description: Threads usernames, with or without @, or full profile URLs. Used by mode=profile / profileReplies / profileMedia / profileReposts.
usernames.title: Usernames (profile modes)

title: Threads Scraper Input
